title: Jax Systems — Agent Organization
status: Working v1: on-demand internal analysis and drafts; not autonomous client operations
front_door: Ask Hermes in Telegram with Jax Chief of Staff or a Jax-specific request.
architecture: One Chief of Staff, on-demand specialists, one governed skill library. Not six always-on autonomous businesses.

roles.name: Growth & Market Intelligence
roles.purpose: Find relevant owner problems and prepare evidence-backed positioning and marketing experiments.

roles.name: Sales & Scoping
roles.purpose: Prepare owner meetings, truthful business cases and bounded proposal drafts.

roles.name: Solutions & Delivery
roles.purpose: Prepare implementable designs, test plans and handoffs for bounded systems work.

roles.name: Client Operations & Success
roles.purpose: Prepare onboarding, delivery-status, support and adoption records.

roles.name: Business Operations
roles.purpose: Prepare internal work coordination and business administrative drafts.

roles.name: Quality & Security
roles.purpose: Independently check other role outputs and source/permission boundaries.

proof.automated_tests: 26 automated tests pass, including policy, source, recovery, privacy and idempotency checks.
proof.live_pilots: 3 real internal tasks completed across all six functions; independent model QA on each. One initial route was rejected and one output-limit failure recovered within its task budget. Fresh Hermes skill invocation returned the actual task status.
proof.cost: Known provider charges exceed $0.05995; total unknown because a truncated call did not return usable accounting. No new subscriptions. This is not an account-wide spending limit.

limits: Internal research, analysis, checklists and local drafts only in v1.
No outreach, purchases, signatures, production execution or client-system access.
Workers have no shell, browser, email or banking tools; tool actions are not unlocked by a prompt.
Private task records and source context are never published here.
A separate reviewer and deterministic artifact checks are required; a second opinion is not an audit guarantee.
No Anthropic/Claude models, automatic router or silent model fallback.
